issues.display_title: Issue #32: Fix Country Filter Query Parameter Handling and View Initialization
issues.main_description_html:
Description:

The frontend fails to parse or correctly initialize page data when accessing directory pages via country query strings (e.g., /?country=Canada).

Acceptance Criteria:

  1. Update route query parameter parser to correctly detect country parameters on initial page load.
  2. Trigger appropriate photographer directory API calls passing the parsed country filter.
  3. Ensure browser history and URL navigation update cleanly when switching between country filters.
